No OpenCL GPU device was detected on this system.

KataGo can still run in CPU mode, but analysis speed will be significantly slower.

Suggestions:
• Ensure GPU drivers are installed
• Verify your GPU supports OpenCL
• Or specify a CPU-only config file in settings
